planets.name: EPIC 201238110 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 201238110 with a 28.2-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: EPIC 201238110 b was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 201238110. Its orbit and size follow Heller et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
